messages:
Erin (Finance): FYI — Vendor credit posted against Jan invoice instead of Dec usage. Credit = $48,350. The credit reduced a customer invoice; Sales says it should have applied to Dec. Need guidance for month-end close: reclass JE vs prior-period adj? :eyes:
Tom (Accounting): Is this a vendor rebate or a billing system misapply? Do we have vendor memo or Sales confirmation?
Erin (Finance): Billing mapping error — vendor issued credit memo but our billing job matched it to the Jan invoice. Sales and VendorOps confirmed the credit relates to Dec usage. We have the CM PDF + emails.
Sam (RevOps): If it's legitimately Dec we should move recognition back. Two routes: (A) Post a correcting JE in current period that reclassifies the reduction into deferred revenue with a Dec effective date, or (B) book a prior-period adjustment. Materiality check: $48k vs monthly run-rate ~ $4M — borderline but not immaterial.
Maya (Revenue): Prefer option A for audit trail (correcting JE with full backing). We'll need JE narrative and supporting file links. Also update the revenue schedule after posting.
Erin (Finance): Draft JE below — please review. If approved I'll route to Tom for posting and tag Jared for sign-off.
Tom (Accounting): Share GL numbers and I'll validate formatting for NetSuite import.
Erin (Finance): Draft JE (amounts shown positive = DR):
```
Date: 2026-02-28
DR Revenue - Recognized (GL 4000) ...... $48,350
CR Accounts Receivable (GL 1100) ...... $48,350
-- reverse the recognized revenue reduction that occurred when credit hit the invoice
Date: 2026-02-28
DR Accounts Receivable (GL 1100) ...... $48,350
CR Deferred Revenue (GL 2100) .......... $48,350
-- reclass the customer credit into deferred revenue with Dec effective period
```
Sam (RevOps): Small tweak: include JE reference text "Vendor credit misapplied CM-5567; reclass to Dec deferred revenue; support: vendor memo 2026-02-20". That will make audit tracing straightforward.
Maya (Revenue): I'll update the revenue schedule to decrement Jan recognized amount and reflect the reclass into Dec deferred bucket after JE posts.
billing-bot: Invoice 2026-01-14-98765 had credit CM-5567 applied ($48,350). Links: https://invoices.redwood/98765 , https://files.redwood/vendor-credit-CM-5567.pdf
Tom (Accounting): GL accounts look good. I'll prepare the NetSuite JE as "Reclass vendor credit to prior-period deferred revenue" with posting date 2026-02-28 and attach the vendor memo + Sales confirmation.
Erin (Finance): Do we need CFO sign-off? @Jared (CFO) — can you OK this correcting JE?
Jared (CFO): Quick skim — OK to proceed with correcting JE. Post with the memo and attach the vendor email thread. If auditors ask, we'll disclose as correction for misapplied billing; materiality is close but acceptable for a JE.
Erin (Finance): Great — I'll update the month-end checklist, note the JE ID once posted, and ping Revenue to confirm schedule update. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
